ns2:section.sectionText: This section is online, asynchronous, and also has four individual (1:1) 60-minute meetings, with one course instructor throughout the semester. Cripping Music critically and creatively engages the applied research strategies, creative methodologies, and disciplinary conventions of Music via the Crip* principles of interdependence, open access, generative difference, radical alterity, networks of support and collaboration, Crip temporalities, and access ecology. This course will serve to discover and design new crip-centric approaches and strategies specific to Music.open access, generative difference, radical alterity, networks of support and collaboration, Crip temporalities, and access ecology.
